From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Board Secretariat <board-secretariat@redwoodboard.org>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Q3 snapshot & OKR alignment for Boardbook — please review

Team — attaching the working draft of the Q3 snapshot that we'll include in the Boardbook next week. High-level asks: please do a quick pass for accuracy and for any material that needs to be escalated to the board (policy changes, SLA exceptions, or sensitive customer escalations).

What's in this draft:
- Executive summary slide with the growth/cost/latency highlights
- OKR progress page (rollups from Product/Infra/GTMS)
- Two customer spotlights (Acct A + Prospect B)

Immediate requests:
1) Evelyn — can you validate the infra latency numbers on slide 6 and add a one-line note about the mitigation plan for the caching regression we hit in Sep?
2) Vivek — please confirm the committed ARR and any contract renewals to call out (specifically the ACME expansion).
3) Grace — tidy the OKR language so it reads board-level (no tactical Jira refs), and flag any off-track items for discussion.

Timeline: I'd like edits back by 3pm PT today so we can send a clean version to Kate (Morgan Stanley) and the Board Secretariat by EOD.

Attachments:
- [Attachment: Q3_Snapshot_v3.pptx (pptx)]
- [Attachment: OKR_change_log.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks — Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q3 snapshot & OKR alignment for Boardbook — please review

Karthik — quick pass attached. Two quick notes inline and summarized below.

Inline changes:
- Slide 6 (Latency): adjusted the median P50/P95 numbers — P95 for text-gen on dedicated nodes is 210ms (was listed as 180ms). I added a footnote referencing the Oct change to kernel scheduling.
- Slide 7 (Mitigation): added a one-liner about rolling back the batching tweak for <low-priority> workloads and a timeline for a permanent fix (expected by mid-Dec).

Summary:
- The numbers in v3 were optimistic for P95; I've corrected and added an explicit risk flag to the exec summary.
- OKR: marked INFRA-OKR-2 (latency) as "At Risk" and added a short remediation list.

Attachments: quick redline of Q3_Snapshot_v3.pptx (comments)

Evelyn
--
Evelyn Hart
VP, Infrastructure Reliability | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q3 snapshot & OKR alignment for Boardbook — please review

Thanks — saw Evelyn's notes and they look good. A couple of items from GTM finance side: 

- Committed ARR: I've updated the slide to show $28.6M committed for Q4 bookings (was previously $27.9M). The ACME expansion is in the "committed" bucket; I'll attach the signed amendment.
- Renewal note: We're recommending we call out the renewal with Orion Health as a signal of traction in regulated health verticals — adding a one-line bullet under "Customer highlights."

Question for the group: do we want the board to see the expanded ACME pricing terms (they're not public) or should we summarize as "expanded scope, public reference available upon request"? My recommendation: summarize unless Legal asks for redlines now.

Attaching: ACME_Amendment_signed.pdf (attachment stub)

Vivek
--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
From: Kate Liu <kate.liu@ms.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Board Secretariat <board-secretariat@redwoodboard.org>
Date: 2026-11-15T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q3 snapshot & OKR alignment for Boardbook — please review

Karthik — thanks for sending. Quick read-through notes from our side (Board Liaison team at Morgan Stanley):

- Exec summary: can you add one line contextualizing the latency variance to how it impacts customer SLAs? The board likes to see the concrete customer impact framed up front.
- Financials: the board packet prefers rounded figures (e.g., $28.6M -> $28.6M is fine, but don't show cent-level detail).
- Sensitive terms: please do not include contract-level commercial terms in the public packet. If you need the board to review, route via Legal and Board Secretariat as an appendix.

Also — can we get a clean PDF version of the deck by 11/16 noon PT? That would help the Secretariat compile the packet.

Kate Liu
Senior Board Liaison | Morgan Stanley Advisors
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-16T17:45:00-08:00
Subject: Final Q3 snapshot — cleaned version uploaded for Boardbook

Team/Kate — thanks for the rapid responses. I've incorporated Evelyn's latency corrections, Vivek's ARR update, and Grace's language edits (tucked tactical notes into the appendix). Per Kate's ask, sensitive commercial terms have been removed from the public slides and will be made available to Legal/Board Secretariat in a separate appendix.

Deliverables uploaded:
- Q3_Snapshot_v3_FINAL.pdf (public board packet)
- Q3_Snapshot_v3_INTERNAL.pptx (internal deck with comments)
- OKR_change_log.xlsx (finalized, showing status flags)

Drive links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBoardbook2026 (public packet), and I've shared the internal deck with Legal and Board Secretariat.

Next steps: Kate/Secretariat — please confirm receipt and whether you need anything else before you compile the packet. Grace — please file the finalized OKR_change_log in Notion under the "Boardbook Q3" page.

Thanks — Karthik
